Forget about everything else people say. Wether you like the new systems or not is subjective. But the real issue with this game is the extremely poor optimisation. Why did they write those minimum requirments when I can't run it with way better ones? I've tried everything that came to mind, I searched forums, I did all the things they told me to do and I still can't get a nice, enjoyable experience. My computer does get 120 fps, but it simply is not constant enough to play, every couple of seconds dropping to like 40 fps, or even lower, to 20's or a complete stop. Why? Why can't they make a good fucking game? Advanced Warfare had the same problems, I liked that game, however I did not enjoy it crashing way too often. This is just unbelivable. I'll continue to search for possible fixes but even if I find something that works, I won't change my opinion. I shouldn't have to tinker with my game for hours to get a playable experience.

Call of Duty: Black Ops III left me with mixed feelings, but in a good way. I actually enjoyed the campaign for its darker, more ambitious story, even if it was messy at times, while the multiplayer never really grabbed me with its chaotic, jetpack-heavy style. The real highlight was Zombies, which I consider the best part of the game—packed with creative maps, deep Easter eggs, and endless replayability—and the ability to play modded maps kept it fresh and gave the mode an even longer life.

K so obviously, the zombies is a must-play. It's pretty different from what other zombies modes from other CoD games have, but overall its still pretty fun with just as many convoluted easter eggs. If anything I bought this game exclusively for zombies.
However, the multiplayer is ridiculous and chaotic, because wall-running and jetbooster-assisted flight makes every game a shitshow and near-impossible to gauge where enemies are at any given point in time. Its a HUGE shift from other CoD multiplayer experiences, and I honestly found it really hard to play it when I literally get headshot by a flying shotgunner or some jet-sliding knifer.
The campaign is really forced, a lot of the assets are ripped straight from the zombies game, and the plot is just too complicated to follow. It tries to merge its storyline with the zombies storyline, but its pretty obvious that most of the work in the game came to fleshing out the zombies plot.

At this point, if you are looking to buy Black Ops 3 for multiplayer, I wouldn't. The game will be seven years old this year and the player base is incredibly small for two main reasons: it is a pre-2019 Call of Duty on PC and it is just plain old.

Don't get me wrong, the multiplayer for this game can be quite enjoyable but the amount of players can ruin it.

However, I strongly recommend this game for vanilla zombies, custom zombies, and the inclusion of a four player campaign. The amount of content for zombies in this game alone justifies this purchase IF the game is on sale.

Bottom line: Buy it for the zombies if its on sale, don't cave in to Activision's disillusion that this game is still worth launch price.

Gameplay is fantastic. Customization is boundless. Zombies has a great esthetic with various maps. The main story is amazing to play through (and can be done with a friend alongside you). Obviously the story follows a linear route, but that did not deter me from it, and it certainly did not make me enjoy the fascinating world any less. The sci-fi aspect of this game is unique and incorporates very interesting mechanics into the game (like hacking, cybernetic enhancements, and wall running). I would recommends this game to anyone that falls into one or more of these categories:

- first-person shooters
- Story driven war dramas
- Wave survival (AKA zombies)
- Online multiplayer
- Sci fi
- Unique mechanics
- Loadout customization & weapon design

For what you get, it is well worth buying if you fall into several of these categories.

I will mainly talk about the zombies mode for this review since i play BO3 for the zombies. BO3 Zombies is the best cod zombies game ever made. Great graphics with amazing gameplay. This game perfected the cod zombies formula without changing the game mechanics. The game added specialist weapons, extra health, and new pack a punch system. Specialist weapons made the game easier and can get you out of sticky situation. You also can take 3 hits before going down. In previous games, it will take you 2 hits before going down. You can get an alternate ammo type for your weapon by pack a punching you weapon twice. Despite these amazing changes, the game also have cracked zombies. The zombies now have increased attack speed and they can instantly down you in just a second.

If you are bored with the original maps, you can still play custom maps made by people in the cod zombies community. People can play amazing maps made by people who love the game and they made the maps for free. You can also play with other cod's weapons like Cold War for example. This is only possible because of BO3 Mod Tools. The game has mod tools that allows you to create your own zombies maps and mods. Custom maps and BO3 Mod Tools made the game have unlimited potential.

WARNING: THIS GAME IS COMPROMISED

Your safety and security are at risk playing this game, the only means to play this game safely has been shut down by a cease and desist. Hackers and Modders can back door into your computer just from you logging into the main menu. Offline mode is recommended when playing but even then I have no clue if that is still safe.

Remote Code Execution is a flaw in every old Call of Duty from Black Ops III and older. It allows malicious people to execute code on your system through the Black Ops III client and reset your progress, delete your store purchases, access sensitive information, or even upload viruses to your machine. EXTREME CAUTION IS ADVISED WHEN PLAYING THIS GAME! If you have a suspicion that your system has been compromised please Alt+4 immediately and shut down your system. Take it to a professional and change any and all passwords.

Do NOT attempt to play this game if you are not sure of how to get around this exploit safely and securely. Custom games is not safe, and private lobbies are not safe.
